acceptanceCriteria: A CPU profile of go test ./internal/tasks/authority shows fixtureSession.check under 25% of fixture CPU
Existing escape/symlink authority tests still pass and a new test proves a parent swapped to a symlink mid-session is still refused
Before/after wall time recorded in a build-log entry
body: Observed by lane test-speed-1021g (PR #1447, V1-0348) profiling internal/tasks/authority tests on build 702: the product fixtureSession.check path re-opens safeopen.Root and Lstats every parent directory on each operation, accounting for ~66% of fixture CPU. After t.Parallel the package still takes 96 s (load 15-56) and 274 s at load ~270. Expected: per-session root handle reuse or a cached parent-chain verification that keeps the same symlink/escape guarantees, cutting authority test wall time materially.

title: internal/tasks/authority: fixtureSession.check (safeopen.Root + per-parent Lstat per operation) is 66% of authority fixture test CPU
